title: Green/Yellow Robin
summary: A new Leader from EB-05. It uses Characters with the Wisdom attribute: your Leader readies one each turn, and when one of them (without [Blocker]) is K.O.'d, you add a card to your Life. Many cards are [Trigger]s, so taking damage helps you too.
gamePlan: Early turns: Atlas and Lilith dig for Wisdom and [Trigger] cards. Charlotte Pudding draws 3.
Use the Leader's Activate effect to set a Wisdom Character with 6000 power or less as active, so it can attack twice or defend after attacking.
Nico Robin (EB05-016) plays a 5-cost Wisdom Character from your hand for free. Nami (EB05-055) adds a Life card.
When your Wisdom Characters get K.O.'d, your Leader adds a Life card. Trading Characters is good for you.
Finish with Shanks (OP17-022): [Rush], 12000 power, and it rests all of your opponent's Characters.

keyCards.why: Leader. Readies a Wisdom Character, and gains Life when one is K.O.'d.
Nico Robin. Plays a Wisdom Character costing 5 or less for free.
Nami. Adds a Life card on your turn.
Charlotte Pudding. Trash a [Trigger] card to draw 3.
Shanks. [Rush] finisher that rests every opposing Character.
Gloriosa. Takes damage for you by going to the trash.

howItWins: You trade Characters and gain Life each time, then Shanks rests your opponent's whole board for a big final attack.
weakTo: Effects that remove Characters without K.O.ing them (no Life gain).
mulliganTips: Keep Atlas or Lilith plus a Wisdom Character. Shanks can wait.
